name: TrustCaptcha
author: trustcaptcha

sections.description:
Privacy-friendly CAPTCHA solution with bot score. Protect your website from bot attacks and spam with our invisible and GDPR-compliant reCAPTCHA alternative. Benefit from our multi-layered security concept with proof-of-work and intelligent bot score for reliable bot detection.

Supported Plugins:

  • BBPress New Topic
  • BBPress Reply
  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Forminator
  • Gravity Forms
  • Mailchimp for WordPress
  • Ninja Forms
  • Ninja Forms Multi Step
  • WordPress Comments
  • WordPress Login
  • WordPress Lost Password
  • WordPress Registration
  • WooCommerce Login
  • WooCommerce Registration
  • WooCommerce Checkout
  • WooCommerce Lost Password
  • WP Forms

Short Description

Privacy-friendly CAPTCHA solution with bot score.

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses TrustCaptcha, a third-party service, to provide CAPTCHA verification for bot protection. By using this plugin, requests are sent to the TrustCaptcha servers to verify CAPTCHA challenges. This requires sharing certain data (e.g., the user’s IP address and CAPTCHA responses) with TrustCaptcha.

Service URL: TrustCaptcha Homepage
Terms of Service: TrustCaptcha Terms and Conditions
Privacy Policy: TrustCaptcha Privacy Policy

TrustCaptcha is GDPR compliant and is hosted on servers within the EU. Please make sure that the use of this third-party service complies with your local regulations. This plugin relies on TrustCaptcha for CAPTCHA verification, and using the service involves data transmission to TrustCaptcha’s servers.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugin browser or by uploading the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/trustcaptcha directory.
  2. Create a TrustCaptcha account at TrustCaptcha and create a new captcha.
  3. Obtain your Captcha Credentials (site-key and secret-key, which can be found here) and enter them in the TrustCaptcha settings in WordPress (Settings -> TrustCaptcha).
  4. Activate TrustCaptcha for all desired plugins.
  5. Insert TrustCaptcha in all desired forms, if TrustCaptcha does not do this automatically.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0

  • Update TrustCaptcha widget to 3.0.0 (now self-hosted in the plugin — no external CDN dependency)
  • Update TrustCaptcha PHP library to 3.0.0
  • Add failover support: optional “Failover Enabled” toggle that lets visitors through when our servers are temporarily unreachable (server-side ServerUnreachable only — client-reported failover is always rejected)
  • Add a “Test connection” button on the settings page to verify your server can reach the TrustCaptcha API
  • Rename “Secret key” to “API key”, “Hide branding” to “White label / Hide branding”, “Mode” to “Minimal data mode”
  • Raise the minimum allowed threshold to 0.2 to prevent accidental lockout

2.2.1

  • Add support for Forminator multi-step (paginated) forms: CAPTCHA is now rendered on the final step before the submit button

2.2.0

  • Update TrustCaptcha version to 2.2.0
  • Update TrustCaptcha PHP library to 2.0.1
  • Fix loading of vendor/autoload.php
  • Improve FluentForms implementation

2.0.1

  • Fix Elementor Pro Bug

2.0.0

  • TrustCaptcha in now part of TrustComponent

1.3.0

  • Update to TrustCaptcha version 1.9.0 – this includes, among other things:
  • Captcha box accessibility improvements
  • Improve data privacy
  • Border corner radius changeable
  • Translation improvements and new translations for screen reader / aria labels: es, fr, it, nl and lb
  • Show privacy url only if a custom privacy url is set
  • Remove captcha slider

1.2.1

  • Add support for WordPress 6.8.x
  • Fix custom translation bug
  • Fix custom design bug

1.2.0

  • Add proxy support
  • Add support for plugins: WPForms Pro

1.1.0

  • Refactor code and improve user experience
  • Update from TrustCaptcha v1.5.x to v1.8.x
  • Add support for plugins: BBPress, Elementor Forms, Fluent Forms, Forminator, Mailchimp, Ninja Forms

1.0.0

  • Initial release
